anomalies.observed: J5 (channel 1 servo signal) connects through R21 to /NET0014, which is tied via R20 to J2 pin 20 and via R9 to J2 pin 22. J8 (channel 2 servo signal) connects through R11 to /NET0042, which is tied via R4 to J2 pin 19 and via R14 to J2 pin 21. Thus channel 1 uses bus pins 20/22 and channel 2 uses bus pins 19/21.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the PWM channel 1 should be supplied from M5Stack bus pins 19/21 and channel 2 from pins 20/22. Therefore J5 should connect to pins 19/21 and J8 to pins 20/22.

evidence.quote: Select which M5Stack bus pin (pin 19/21 for ch.1, pin 20/22 for ch.2) supplies PWM1/PWM2

anomalies.impact: In PWM mode the pan and tilt servo channels are crossed: the firmware PWM1 output on pins 19/21 drives the J8 servo header, and PWM2 on pins 20/22 drives the J5 header. This swaps the pan and tilt functions.

anomalies.observed: All six 0 Ω jumpers R4, R7, R9, R10, R14 and R20 are present with value 0. R7 shorts the MAX3485 A line (/NET0001) to J5 signal (Net-(J5-Pin_3)), and R10 shorts J5 signal to J8 signal (Net-(J8-Pin_3)) for serial mode. At the same time R20/R9 and R4/R14 select and connect the PWM bus pins to those same signal nets.
anomalies.expected: The specification says the PWM and serial servo interface modes are mutually exclusive and selected by populating different 0 Ω jumpers. For a given build, either the PWM-selection jumpers or the serial-bridging jumpers should be populated, but not both. PWM mode should leave the serial bridges open; serial mode should not populate the PWM-selection jumpers.

Serial mode (populate R13/R14, per the explicit schematic annotation "Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo")

J1/J2 top/bottom M5Stack bus connectors identical. Netlist has J2 and J6? Wait spec says J1/J2 are Conn_02x15. However spec says J6 PortB, J10 external 5V, J3/J8 servo, J5 BAT. Netlist components: J3 value BAT but footprint JST_PH_B2B-PH-K_1x02, libsource Conn_01x02. J8 is Conn_01x03. J10 is 5V_POWER Conn_01x02. J11 Conn_01x04. So actual ref mapping seems: J3 = BAT (1x02), J5 = servo header? J10 = 5V_POWER, J11 = PortB 4pin, J2/J6 bus connectors. C4-C7 = 4*100u on servo rail. Spec C1-C4. Roles match.

Some J2 pins involve other nets (R etc). J6 for lower pass-through? We'll need check bus pin mappings. Spec: J1/J2 identical nets on both so board can stack between core and lower module. Netlist has J2 and J6 as the two bus connectors. They share same nets on pins mostly. But pin 11 +3V3, 27 +5V, 29 BAT, 15 TXD2, 16 RXD2, 19/20/21/22 GPIO? Need inspect.

J3 value BAT (1x02) pins: pin1 Net-(J3-Pin_1) with Q2 S and R17; pin2 GND. Hmm that's not battery input; it's a 2-pin connector with pin1 connected to Q2 source (P-FET) and R17, pin2 GND. That matches spec Q1 high-side battery disconnect (but ref Q2). J3 is battery connector (value BAT). Its pin1 to Q2 source, pin2 GND. Gate controlled by SW2 and R17 to something?
